description:

Simple vegetable side dishes include steamed spinach, sautéed broccoli rabe, roasted cauliflower steaks, brown sugar-glazed carrots, sautéed sugar snap peas and shelled peas with mint and lemony kale salad.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E7 — Hens and Chicks
Now with over 200 chickens and 20 different breeds, Martha shares her vast knowledge about raising and caring for her flock; learn the how-tos of building a coop.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E8 — Martha Builds a Raised Bed Vegetable Garden
Martha builds a brand new, half-acre raised bed vegetable garden on her farm! It's a step-by-step guide to designing, building, preparing the soil, and planting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E9 — Everything's Coming Up Roses
Everything is coming up roses on Martha's Bedford farm; Martha is creating a brand-new rose garden with almost 200 roses; from color to fragrance, the inspired world of roses is a very good thing.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E10 — Azaleas, Hostas, and Wild Birds
Martha's azalea grove is bursting with the last flowers of spring; then everything you need to know about hostas; Martha takes up bird watching.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E6 — Sensational Summer Salads
Martha and Salad Freak author Jess Dameck reveal the art of constructing the perfect salad; Martha and Sarah Carey share a new twist on the classic Caesar salad and create a roasted beet salad.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E7 — Martha Throws a Clam Bake
Martha heads to her local seafood market, Mt. Kisco Seafood, to pick up the perfect ingredients for a clam bake; broiled salmon and delicious creamed spinach.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E8 — Rustic Italian Cuisine
Martha visits Il Buco Alimentari with chef Justin Smillie and fries artichokes to crispy perfection; they construct a salad with anchovy crumbs followed by spaghetti bottarga and charred duck.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E9 — Exploring Korean Cuisine
Martha dines at the Korean restaurant NARO and begins her culinary journey with two Korean cocktails; Martha and executive chef Nate Kuester make reimagined versions of traditional Korean cuisine.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E10 — Martha's Favorite Brunch
Martha prepares a brunch menu with whitefish salad from Acme Smoked Fish Corp and crafts a cocktail featuring two brunch staples; Martha makes her favorite frittata dish and bakes a rhubarb crisp.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E1 — Ice Cream Show
Martha makes homemade ice cream with Van Leeuwen Ice Cream co-founder, Ben Van Leeuwen; Martha assembles ice cream sandwiches with homemade cookies and makes hot fudge.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E3 — Mexican Cuisine
Chef Lazaro Perez joins Martha in her kitchen to cook a fiesta-inspired feast of carnitas and homemade tortillas, shrimp in a spicy chili sauce, and the iconic Martha-rita.
